title: Hierarchy and Pivot Painter packaging
summary: Build or validate deterministic piece hierarchy and local pivots, pack exporter-version-compatible data, and verify synchronized geometry and textures.

use_when: hierarchical rigid-part or vegetation deformation is driven by a game shader
avoid_when: skeletal animation is the required runtime representation

inputs: exporter and engine profile with element limits
acceptance: pivots and local bases are finite
mesh and textures share one hierarchy revision
rollback: export to a new versioned directory
